Dansk version længere nede

Bonde Glas is looking for a qualified carpenter with knowledge or experience of the glazing trade to join our team on Lolland in southern Denmark.

You’ll need to already have the legal right to work in Denmark (for example, EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship, or a valid Danish work and residence permit). Unfortunately, we’re not able to offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Your role

You will work with a wide range of carpentry tasks and work closely with the glazing side of the company. We are therefore looking for a carpenter who is comfortable with varied practical work and interested in working across the two trades.

Who you are

• 
You are a qualified carpenter

• 
You have knowledge or practical experience of the glazing trade

• 
You have a valid driving licence

• 
You can communicate in English

• 
Is willing to relocate to Lolland and make the area your place of residence

• 
A valid asbestos training certificate is a strong advantage

What we offer

• 
Gross hourly wage: DKK 150-200, depending on qualifications and experience

• 
Permanent employment, 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday

• 
Occasional overtime may occur, but weekend work is generally not required

• 
Pension scheme

• 
Flexible benefits account for extra vacation, salary or pension

• 
Assistance with finding suitable accommodation

About Bonde Glas

Bonde Glas is a local glazing company on Lolland. In addition to glazing work, the company also employs carpenters and carries out a wide range of practical assignments.

Recruitment Process

The first interview can be conducted online if required. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the workplace before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Please send your application to rekruttering@lolland.dk and write “Bonde Glas” in the subject line.

If you have questions about the position, please contact:

Martin Hansen
Business Consultant and EURES adviser, Lolland Municipality
Phone: +45 21 47 73 43
Email: maha@lolland.dk

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and Relocation Support

Lolland is located in the southern part of Denmark, offering a peaceful lifestyle with easy access to nature, beaches, and open countryside. The region combines affordable housing, short commuting distances, and a strong sense of community.

The region is currently experiencing significant development, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link, one of Europe’s largest infrastructure projects, which will create a direct road and rail connection between Denmark and Germany.

As an international employee, you will have access to Lolland Municipality’s Newcomers Service, which offers free support with relocation, registration, housing guidance, partner job support, and settling into life in Denmark.

For more information about Lolland and contact details, visit newcomers.lolland.dk

More information about living and working in Denmark can be found at www.workindenmark.dk

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral position in the SpeedyFermHub research project
jobs.description:
Will you be part of shaping the future of fermented plant-based foods? Do you want to explore how consumers respond to novel plant-based food innovations and how consumer insights can inform product development, market positioning and societal value? Then join the SpeedyFermHub research project as a postdoctoral researcher at the Department of Management, Aarhus University.

We invite applications for a 24-month postdoctoral position starting in 2027. The position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a new research project focusing on consumer-citizen acceptance, market positioning and the societal relevance of fermented plant-based food innovations. 

The starting date is 1 March 2027 or subject to mutual agreement.

The research project
The postdoctoral position is part of the externally funded FutureFoodS project SpeedyFermHub – which aims to support the development, optimization and scale-up of fermented plant-based food prototypes. Within the project, the Department of Management at Aarhus University contributes expertise in consumer behavior and food marketing, with a particular focus on consumer-citizen acceptance, stakeholder-informed product development, market relevance and societal positioning. The project is expected to generate high-quality research on how consumers evaluate novel fermented plant-based foods and how consumer insights can inform product refinement, communication strategies and market positioning.

Job description
The successful candidate is expected to contribute to the overall objectives of the project by being involved in design, implementation, data collection, and analysis of consumer-citizen studies related to fermented plant-based food prototypes. Therefore, the candidate will contribute to the development of online experimental consumer and sensory studies, including the design of product concepts, survey materials, experimental stimuli and measures of consumer preferences, acceptance and willingness-to-pay. The candidate is also expected to contribute to the other phases of the research process, including in-person consumer testing of final prototypes, and to support the assessment of market trends, entry potential and societal positioning of fermented plant-based products. The candidate will be involved in data collection, quantitative data analysis, interpretation of findings, preparation of deliverables, writing of academic articles and ongoing development of the project in collaboration with national and international partners. 

The position is research-oriented but may involve teaching assignments.

Qualifications 
Candidates must hold a PhD relevant to the academic areas of the Department of Management, (preferably within one or more of the following areas: consumer behavior, food marketing, marketing, sustainable consumption, behavioral science, agricultural economics, economics, psychology, or related fields.). 

The ideal candidate will have experience with one or more of the following:

• consumer research on food, sustainability, health, innovation or novel foods;
• survey design and online experimental methods;
• quantitative data analysis, preferably including choice modelling, willingness-to-pay analysis, segmentation, multivariate statistics, or related methods;
• consumer acceptance, product concept testing, or sensory-consumer research;
• academic writing and publication in peer-reviewed journals;
• collaboration in interdisciplinary and international research environments.
Experience with software such as R, Python, SPSS, Stata, Sawtooth, Qualtrics or similar tools will be considered an advantage.

The successful candidate should have strong analytical skills, good communication skills, the ability to work independently, and the ability to collaborate with researchers and partners from different disciplinary backgrounds. Excellent written and spoken English is required.

Who we are
The Department of Management is part of Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University – a top 100 university. Aarhus BSS has achieved the triple-crown AACSB, AMBA and EQUIS accreditations.

The department has an international research and teaching environment, employs approximately 160 Danish and international researchers, academic staff, and PhD students. We excel in business management, including strategy, innovation, marketing, organisation, digitalisation, and accounting. Our aim is to deliver high-quality research, with a strong emphasis on publishing in leading academic journals and presenting at recognised conferences.

You can read more about the Department of Management at: http://mgmt.au.dk.

Further information
For further information about the position and the department, please contact Head of Department/project facilitator Associate Professor, Marija Banovic, Tel.: +45 52609827, Email: maba@mgmt.au.dk 

If you need help uploading your application or have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Coordinator Maria Grauert Løvgaard, Email: mgb@au.dk

International applicant? Find information about entering and working in Denmark here

 

Place of work
Aarhus BSS
Department of Management
Universitetsbyen 61

International applicant? 
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information here:
https://internationalstaff.au.dk/relocationservice/

Please find more information about research opportunities at Aarhus University here: http://international.au.dk/research/

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here: 
http://talent.au.dk/junior-researcher-development-programme/

Terms of employment
Salary and terms of employment are governed by the Cirkulære om overenskomst for akademikere i staten  (in Danish). You will be employed as Post doc at base pay level 4–8 with additional supplements in accordance with the Cirkulære om protokollat om visse ansættelsesvilkår for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter (in Danish).

The job content and qualification requirements are described in further detail in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

Application procedure
When you apply for this position it is mandatory to attach the following:

• Application
• Curriculum Vitae. You are encouraged to declare any periods of leave without research activity, including, for example, maternity leave, since your research activities are assessed in relation to your actual research time
• Education (diploma for master's, PhD and possibly higher doctoral degree)
• List of publications (the enclosed publications must be clearly marked on the list of publications)
• Publications. Up to three publications can be included in the application. In the event of several authors the publications must be accompanied by a co-author statement concerning the applicant's share of the collaborative work with the consent of the co-authors. This template may be used for the purpose
• Teaching portfolio. The specific requirements regarding the documentation can be found here
Materials which cannot be uploaded together with the application may be submitted in three copies to Aarhus BSS HR & PhD, Aarhus University, Bartholins Allé 16, DK-8000 Aarhus C.

Read more about how to apply for an academic post at Aarhus BSS here

The evaluation process
After the application deadline, an assessment committee is appointed. Please note that the assessment of applicants is based solely on the material received prior to the application deadline. For further information, see Guidelines for Assessment Committee, Aarhus BSS.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Aarhus University
Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment to its 37,000 students (FTEs) and 8,700 employees and has an annual revenue of EUR 1.106 billion. Learn more at www.international.au.dk/

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Positions in Mathematics
jobs.employer_name: KU- SCIENCE - CHEM og MATH og NBI-HCØ
jobs.description:
Department of Mathematical Sciences, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen

   

  The Department of Mathematical Sciences at the University of Copenhagen is seeking top early-career researchers for a number of attractive one- to three-year postdoctoral positions.

  The salary is very competitive and researchers from outside Denmark may qualify for a reduced tax rate (see terms below).

  The Department of Mathematical Sciences has strong research groups in many areas of mathematics, and has an active postdoc and visitors' program. Applicants in all areas of mathematics covered by the research groups of the department will be considered. In particular, there will be postdoc stipends in the following specific areas/centers of the department:

   	
• Algebraic and arithmetic geometry, applied algebra, geometric group theory, combinatorics, geometry and geometric analysis, Lie theory, representation theory, number theory, and topology, as covered by the Section for Algebra & Geometry and the Copenhagen Centre for Geometry & Topology (GeoTop). 	
• Functional analysis, operator algebras, geometric group theory, descriptive set theory, harmonic and classical analysis, history of mathematics, mathematical physics, partial differential equations, quantum information and quantum computing, as covered by the section Analysis and Quantum, the Center for the Mathematics of Quantum Theory (QMATH), and the Quantum for Life Center.   Further information about the Department of Mathematical Sciences is linked here.
 Inquiries about the position should be made to postdocapply@math.ku.dk. You are also welcome to directly contact any faculty member closest to your research area.

  The postdoc’s duties will include research within mathematics as well as teaching.
 The teaching load is typically two quarter (half-semester) courses per year, of which one usually is as a teaching assistant. The post may also include performance of other duties.
 
 The position is open with starting date in 2027, ordinarily September 1st or October 1st.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.
  

  Terms of employment

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Negotiation for salary supplement is possible. Potential applicants from outside of Denmark can find information about life in Denmark - including taxation, healthcare, etc. – at https://ism.ku.dk/salary-tax-pension

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include:

   	
• Curriculum vitae, including list of publications. 	
• Cover Letter: Substantiate your qualification for the postdoc position and your motivations. 	
• Diplomas: Master and/or PhD degree, or equivalent. If you do not yet have a PhD diploma, please just upload a PDF stating your (expected) PhD date. 	
• Research plan: Description of current and future research plans. 	
• Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers (not mandatory)   The deadline for applications is 15 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1 (midnight local time).

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. We expect to send invitations for interviews in December 2026 or January 2027. The interviews will typically take place in January and February of 2027, and our search is expected to be concluded around April 2027.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process.

jobs.occupation: PhD stipends in Statistics and the mathematics of Insurance and Economics
jobs.employer_name: KU- SCIENCE - CHEM og MATH og NBI-HCØ
jobs.description:
Department of Mathematical Sciences, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen

   

  Department of Mathematical Sciences (MATH) invites applications for PhD stipends in Statistics and the mathematics of Insurance and Economics.

  The start date is ordinarily September 1, 2027, but can be subject to negotiation.

  We invite applications for PhD stipends in the following areas, all within the sections of Insurance and Economics and Statistics and Probability Theory:

   	
• Optimal transport and adapted Wasserstein metrics (contact Johannes Wiesel, wiesel@math.ku.dk) 	
• Causality and reliable ML at the Copenhagen Causality Lab. Applicants should propose their own angle and argue how it fits the group and wider network, including the Pioneer Centre for AI and SMARTbiomed (see https://sweichwald.de/#research-with-us). 	
• Other areas within statistics, mathematics-economics, and actuarial science besides those mentioned above (contact PhD coordinator Helle Sørensen, helle@math.ku.dk)   We encourage you to specify preferred project(s) and supervisor(s) in your application. 

  You are welcome to contact any member of the sections of Insurance and Economics and Statistics and Probability Theory to discuss research projects.

   

  Who are we looking for?

  We are looking for candidates with an education in Statistics, Insurance, Economics or nearby fields and with strong mathematical qualifications.

   

  About the department

  The department has about 50 permanent scientific staff members, around 60 PhD students and 35 postdocs. It has strong research groups in many areas of mathematics and active PhD, postdoc, and visitors' programs. Our buildings are located in central Copenhagen next to the central park Fælledparken. Our website http://www.math.ku.dk/english provides more information about the department and the research conducted at the department https://www.math.ku.dk/english/research/.  We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment.

  You can find more information about the PhD program on the homepage http://www.math.ku.dk/english/programmes/ph.d/. 

   

  The PhD programme 

  Depending on your level of education, you can undertake the PhD programme as either:

  Option A: A three year full-time study within the framework of the regular PhD programme (5+3 scheme), if you already have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree.

  Option B: An up to five year full-time study programme within the framework of the integrated MSc and PhD programme (the 3+5 scheme), if you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master´s degree – but you have an education equivalent to a Danish bachelors´s degree.

  ********************************************************************************

  Option A: Getting into a position on the regular PhD programme 

  Qualifications needed for the regular programme
 To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. [relevant educations]. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

  Terms of employment in the regular programme 
 Employment as PhD fellow is full time and for maximum 3 years.

  Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant with the help of the supervisor.

  Terms of appointment and payment according to the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

  Option B: Getting into a position on the integrated MSc and PhD programme

  Qualifications needed for the integrated MSc and PhD programme 

  If you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master´s degree, you might be qualified for the integrated MSc and PhD programme, if you have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish bachelor´s degree. Here you can find out, if that is relevant for you: General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.  

  Terms of the integrated programme
 To be eligible for the integrated scholarship, you are (or are eligible to be) enrolled at one of the faculty’s master programmes. Students on the integrated programme will enroll as PhD students simultaneously with completing their enrollment in this MSc degree programme.

  The duration of the integrated programme is up to five years and depends on the amount of credits that you have passed on your MSc programme. For further information about the study programme, please see: www.science.ku.dk/phd, “Study Structures”.

jobs.occupation: Senior IT Windows Server Architect
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As Senior IT Windows Server Architect, you will set the vision for the Windows Server operating system platform across Novo Nordisk, and turn it into a roadmap. You will be the architectural authority for two segregated environments: the General Network for enterprise IT services and the Production Network for business-critical production systems. Your decisions will shape how the platform is designed, secured, automated and run for years to come, keeping the systems our business depends on stable every day.

What you’ll bring

You are an established architect who has already set direction for Windows Server platforms in large enterprise companies. You will bring:

· A proven track record in architecture roles, such as Windows Server Architect or Infrastruc-ture Architect, in large, complex enterprise organisations.

· A clear, well-reasoned vision for building a best-in-class Windows Server operating system platform, and the ability to turn that vision into roadmaps, standards and decisions.

· Deep expertise in Windows Server architecture and engineering at scale, including Active Di-rectory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI/certificate services and Windows authentication.

· Expert knowledge of Windows Server security and hardening, privileged access and adminis-trative security models, risk management and lifecycle management.

· Experience architecting high availability, clustering, backup, disaster recovery and resilience for business-critical production environments.

· Experience designing for strict network segregation, including segmentation, firewalls, load balancing and secure communication between network zones.

· A strong grasp of virtualisation (preferably VMware and/or Hyper-V), monitoring and enter-prise management platforms, PowerShell automation and patching architecture.

· The ability to translate business, security and operational requirements into practical archi-tecture, document it clearly and win support for it across teams.

Useful, but not essential:

· Experience with Azure, Azure Arc, hybrid infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and modern automation platforms (highly desirable).

· Experience from regulated, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, financial, healthcare or other highly controlled environments.

What you’ll do

Together with the product owner, you will decide where the platform goes next. This is a strate-gic architecture role, not day-to-day server administration. You will:

· Own the enterprise Windows Server architecture, vision, roadmap and standards across the General and Production environments.

· Define and govern secure, standardised platforms, covering configuration, networking, stor-age, virtualisation, monitoring, backup and recovery.

· Set the security architecture and hardening standards for privileged access, authentication, service accounts, certificates, vulnerability management and compliance.

· Design architectures for segregated networks with secure integrations, controlled access, and high availability and disaster recovery standards that meet business recovery objectives.

· Lead modernisation, including upgrades, migrations, automation, Infrastructure as Code and reducing technical debt.

· Act as the senior technical authority, leading architectural governance and design reviews, and guiding infrastructure, security and application teams.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Server Platform sub-department within Infrastructure Platforms, part of Enter-prise IT & Quality. The team operates and manages all enterprise servers at Novo Nordisk, cov-ering Windows and Linux in both public and private cloud. Its goal is to streamline server opera-tions across platforms and domains, so they run fast, reliably and in line with compliance re-quirements.

You will work with colleagues in the Philippines, India, Poland, the Czech Republic, Denmark and the United States. Alongside the product owner, you will partner with infrastructure engineer-ing, operations, cybersecurity, network, application, cloud and enterprise architecture teams. Your job is to bring them together around clear architectural decisions and move them forward.

Your hiring manager will be [insert hiring manager name and title].

What you can expect here

You will own the architecture of a platform the whole company relies on. You will be trusted to set direction, challenge convention and make your voice heard, then commit with the team once a decision is made. Working across two very different environments and a global team, you will keep building your skills as the platform moves towards hybrid cloud and automation.

[Insert locally relevant benefits and employment conditions.]

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corre-sponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incen-tives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here: [insert link].

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you have the experience and the vision to build a best-in-class Win-dows Server platform, apply for the Senior IT Windows Server Architect role by 1 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals, and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The immersion engineering team is looking for a Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer to strengthen the team. Immersion engineering is taking care of all calculations regarding tunnel elements float up (weight analysis, determine ballast concrete and water, longitudinal section forces, floating stability), transfers in basins and harbour (winch operations with or without vessel assistance), mooring of the tunnel elements, transport to offshore location, immersion (including but not limited to dynamic analyses) and the stability of the elements after immersion.

As the Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer, you will coordinate and participate in the team responsible for floating up and/or hoisting the concrete tunnel elements, equipping them in the port and then transporting and installing them at sea. In a first phase you will participate in the preparation of this crucial operation, by making ballast plans e.g.. In a second phase, you will be part of the operational team that does the immersion work, by going offshore and assist the Immersion Master by giving technical advice. This is what you are prepared to do in Denmark (full time or in 4-2 rotation).

Main tasks and responsibilities:

• As Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer, you will focus on coordination of the tasks for the team and manage the stakeholders

• During the preparatory phase, you are responsible for the ballast plans and float up calculations.

• You take part in the interface management with other departments within FLC regarding specific parts of the T&I scope

• You will coordinate part of the design scope between Work Preparations and the design team based in the Netherlands and Belgium

• You are involved in the management/operation of Tunnel Control Systems

• You ensure the conclusions and results from the design documents are correctly taken over in the work method statements, drawings and operation manuals for the Immersion Pontoon specific operations related to the overall transport and immersion scope

• You liaise with the Marine Warranty Surveyor and contribute to the work procedures, Go/No Go procedures

• During float up and ballasting you check if operations stay within boundary conditions and act accordingly

• During the execution phase, you advise during the transport and installation of the elements. You will be present in the command unit of the immersion pontoons during offshore operations. You will do checks during execution, monitor the immersion process, and have an advisory role to the one in charge of the operation. You are also prepared and ready to deal with contingencies if any might occur

• After immersion, you will organize and do checks on data to create lessons learned for next operations

Qualifications:

• You are a qualified naval architect/maritime engineer/offshore engineer with minimum of 7 years experience

• You have prior experience with immersion of large structures or offshore lifting operations

• You have a good understanding of stability calculations, mooring calculations and hydrodynamics

• You are a hands-on problem solver and a decision maker

• You are a team player with strong communication skills

• You find it a challenge to work in a international, multi-cultural work-environment in which communication and team spirit is key to success

• You are fluent in English.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company.

Full time employment with health insurance and lunch arrangement available upon request.

Workplace:

Based in Rødbyhavn.

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible and. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

VP Sales Europe

Based out of Teton’s headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our product alleviates administrative inefficiencies and observational tasks that overburden healthcare professionals, enabling them to provide better patient care.

Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI, and desktop and mobile applications, Teton helps create a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real-time data insights, creating a digital twin of resident states and care delivery that empowers healthcare providers with actionable intelligence for optimal decision-making.

With strong demand and clear product-market fit, Teton is focused on scaling its presence across Europe. We operate through a Country Director model across three established territories - the Nordics (Copenhagen), UK&I (London), and the DACH region (Zurich) - selling into both public hospital systems and care home operators. This is a rare opportunity to lead an established multi-country commercial organisation, bring consistency and governance across territories, and open Teton’s next European markets.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Lead, coach, and develop Teton’s European sales organisation in the Nordics, UK&I, and DACH, holding each territory accountable to its new business targets.

• 
Own and optimise Teton’s European commercial operating cadence across pipeline generation, tender and bid qualification, deal progression, forecasting, CRM governance, performance management, and team accountability - creating a consistent governance structure across territories while respecting local market differences.

• 
Act as a hands-on deal leader on Europe's largest opportunities, across both public tenders and complex private enterprise deals - joining critical customer meetings, site visits, and executive presentations to bring deals over the line.

• 
Optimise go-to-market in each territory: segmentation, coverage model, territory design, resourcing, and partner strategy across public hospital systems and private and public care home operators.

• 
Evaluate and open new core European markets, such as the Benelux region - building the market-entry case, the operating model, and the initial commercial footprint.

• 
Recruit, onboard, and develop commercial leadership and talent as Europe scales, while raising the effectiveness of the existing teams.

• 
Represent Teton at major European industry conferences, national associations, while helping refine go-to-market strategy, messaging, pricing, and commercial execution across the region.

What We’re Looking For

• 
Significant experience selling and leading teams that sell large and complex contracts won through public sector tenders and RFPs - a genuine command of the public procurement motion is essential for this role.

• 
Equivalent enterprise experience closing large, complex contracts with private organisations, as both motions exist across Teton’s European territories.

• 
A demonstrated track record as a highly successful individual contributor, consistently exceeding significant new business quotas and closing complex, high six-figure ACV opportunities across long sales cycles.

• 
Proven sales leadership experience managing, coaching, and developing sales leaders and net-new business teams carrying significant new business quotas, ideally across multiple European countries or territories.

• 
The ability to operate as a true player-coach: strategic enough to optimise the sales organisation and operating model, but hands-on enough to actively influence and close critical deals.

• 
Deep experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving executive buyers, procurement, legal, and ownership groups.

• 
A rigorous, data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, CRM accuracy, qualification, performance management, and sales governance.

• 
Experience building or scaling sales teams, segmentation models, territories, processes, methodologies, and repeatable go-to-market motions, including entering new markets.

• 
Exposure to healthcare, hospital systems or senior living is a strong bonus, but not a requirement.

• 
12+ years in enterprise sales, with at least 5 of those spent leading sales teams.

• 
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with a willingness to travel regularly across Europe.

What We Offer

• 
Competitive salary and participation in our warrant program.

• 
Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

• 
A high-impact leadership position with significant influence over Teton’s European go-to-market strategy, territory structure, and commercial execution.

• 
A vibrant, learning-focused work environment

jobs.occupation: Domain Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Domain Architect to join our Business Engagement and Platform Solutions team, where you will take domain ownership of the application and platform architecture and drive alignment across our architecture practices.

About the job

The role combines architectural ownership with close business engagement. You will define and maintain the target architecture for applications and platforms, contribute to solution design together with our solution architects and delivery teams, and act as a trusted architectural advisor to the business areas you support.

Your key responsibilities

• Take domain ownership of Orifarm's application and platform architecture, including current state, target state and the roadmap between them

• Engage closely with business stakeholders to understand their processes, priorities and ambitions, and translate these into application and platform solutions

• Drive the architecture forum by setting the agenda, preparing decisions and ensuring alignment across the solution, data, integration and infrastructure architecture practices

• Support solution architects and delivery teams through design reviews, architectural guidance and joint solution design

• Develop and maintain reference architectures, design patterns and architectural standards for the application and platform domain

• Drive simplification of the application portfolio through consolidation, lifecycle management and modernization of key applications

• Support the evaluation, selection and integration of new applications and platforms, ensuring that they can be operated and maintained sustainably

Who are you?

We are looking for a pragmatic and business-oriented architect who is comfortable moving between technical design and stakeholder dialogue. You communicate clearly, and you create alignment through collaboration and professional credibility.

We imagine your profile includes:

• +5 years of experience within solution, application or platform architecture, or a background as a senior developer, lead engineer with relevant architectural experience

• Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into concrete application and platform solutions

• Good understanding of cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, as well as ERP ecosystems and modern integration patterns

• Experience facilitating architectural decisions across teams and disciplines, for example through design reviews or architecture forums

• Experience from a regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, life science or medical devices is an advantage

• Knowledge of architecture frameworks is an advantage, with emphasis on practical application rather than formal certification

• Professional proficiency in English. Danish or German is an advantage

Who are we?

You will be part of Business Engagement & Platform Solutions, a function of approximately 40 colleagues across three business-aligned solution teams as well as architecture and integration practices with direct reference to the VP of Corporate IT. Moreover, you will join an organization where IT plays a central role in enabling the business strategy, driving commercial outcomes.

The role offers clear ownership of an architecture domain, close cooperation with senior business stakeholders, and the opportunity to help shape our architecture practice as our organization scales.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Product Services
jobs.description:
Protect the backbone of modern society — by leading the service business behind it. Systematic's National Security & Infrastructure (NSI) unit delivers proven software that helps police, emergency services, intelligence services and critical infrastructure operators detect threats early, coordinate their response and stay resilient against hybrid attacks, cyberattacks and natural disasters. Join NSI as it scales, and take ownership of the customer relationships and 24/7 operations that keep this software running for some of Europe's largest energy operators.

The job

As Senior Manager, Services, you will own the day-to-day running and commercial performance of the service contracts behind our mission-critical software product solutions for major infrastructure customers. You will be the customers' trusted point of contact, responsible for keeping their software operations stable around the clock, while also leading a skilled team and taking a significant role in growing our service business.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Building close, trusted relationships with large customers through regular status and steering meetings

• Driving SLA and incident follow-up in close cooperation with our internal operations team

• Leading and developing a team of technical specialists

• Shaping and growing the NSI service business together with sales, product management and product development

• Owning P&L for individual service contracts, including budgets and forecasts

Joining the team

You will join a technically strong, tight-knit team based in Aarhus, anchored by an experienced architect who acts as technical lead and works directly with customers. The team also carries second- and third-line support and on-call duties, so reliability and trust run deep here.

NSI is still shaping and scaling its business, which means real influence: how we structure our service catalogue, how we work with customers, and how the team grows are all still being defined — and you will take part in defining them. You will work with customers across energy and utilities, with further growth expected towards police, emergency services and intelligence services.

Your qualifications

• Experience delivering or supporting software solutions and services, ideally in a customer-facing operations or hosting setup

• Experience managing large, complex customer relationships and contracts

• People management experience is preferred

• A relevant bachelor's or master’s degree, for example in engineering or business administration

• Fluent English, spoken and written

You are also:

• A strong communicator and relationship builder

• Calm and steady under pressure

• Proactive, and thrive in a dynamic, still-evolving environment

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Jesper Bennike, Senior Director, Operations, NSI.
